letter.role_title: AI / ML Engineer — Purchasing AI Hub (Req 34788)
letter.opening: I am writing to express my strong interest in the AI / ML Engineer position within Volvo Group's Purchasing AI Hub (Requisition ID: 34788) in Bangalore.
letter.profile_intro: As an Applied AI & Machine Learning Engineer currently architecting enterprise agentic platforms and ERP AI systems serving 1M+ active users across 120+ organizations, my background directly aligns with your mandate to turn high-value purchasing opportunities into scalable, secure, and production-ready AI solutions. Combining hands-on experience in Spring AI Model Context Protocol (MCP) server development, LangGraph orchestration, hierarchical RAG architectures, and Azure OpenAI, I specialize in bridging complex enterprise data with low-latency LLM workflows.

achievements.impact: Engineered Spring AI Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool servers for real-time transactional ERP data extraction, and designed a single ReAct loop capability contract layer that reduced multi-agent orchestration overhead by 3x and token consumption by 70%.
Implemented a hierarchical RAG pipeline indexing 10,000+ technical documents using GROBID, pdfplumber, and PostgreSQL/PGVector, achieving a 90%+ Recall@10 retrieval rate.

Developed the Prompt Lab evaluation control plane to systematically log multi-turn reasoning trajectories, tool call payloads, and human preference annotations, establishing a scalable Human Feedback (RLHF) Pipeline and LLM-as-judge benchmarks.
Fortified agentic workflows against OWASP LLM vulnerabilities using phantom-token context propagation, runtime tool monitoring, and trained token-classification models for automated PII redaction.

letter.problems_section: Volvo's vision to transform strategic sourcing, supplier intelligence, and spend management requires production-grade systems capable of reasoning across heterogeneous contracts, supplier networks, and ERP transactions. Having built and optimized mission-critical agentic systems at 1M+ user scale, I am eager to apply my expertise in MCP server development, vector retrieval, and responsible AI governance to accelerate the technical deliverables of Volvo's Purchasing AI Hub.
letter.closing: Thank you for your time and consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical leadership and hands-on engineering background can contribute to shaping sustainable and intelligent transport solutions at Volvo Group.
